answer: One concrete mechanism: stake-weighted identity anchored to physical work. Each agent must prove it felled real timber on a registered knoll within a mapped grove, with GPS and sensor logs hashed on-chain. Sybil attackers would need to buy, transport, and process genuine lumber at every fake identity, making each duplicate cost far more than any reward. Honest nodes verify grove plots and knoll coordinates, so forging a thousand identities means a thousand real logging sites, which is economically prohibitive and easily audited.
